_doc: InputChain (input/jecMakeInputs; was mk_reprocess.C): the steps of the input-creation chain and their arguments, run in this order in one process. Each step updates the pre-fit file of the epoch ('forfit' of config/Inputs.json, or --file). step: reprocess, softRad, globalFitSyst, globalFitRenormPF (the names of --steps). tag: the name of the per-step snapshot (--snapshot DIR writes DIR/<epoch>/<tag>.root); the golden snapshots in input/test/golden/ have these names.

steps._note: not used by the fit today
